exhibits.title: The four questions this scan answers
exhibits.subtitle: Indonesia · short answers and the evidence behind them · detail in chapters 1-5
rows: Where is the gap between chargers and EVs?
In Greater Jakarta, not on the outer islands. The network barely grew in early 2026 while sales doubled; the state plan spreads new units outside Java.
~98 cars per public unit in Jakarta vs ~25 elsewhere; +114 units Dec 2025-May 2026 [Kira estimates] [Jawa Pos May 2026]
Car charging. Swapping has stalled with e-scooter sales; car charging grows with battery-electric car sales.
4,892 SPKLU units vs 1,907 swap stations; e-scooter sales -29% in 2025 [ESDM Feb 2026] [detikOto Jan 2026]
What drives use, and what does it mean for utilisation?
Chinese brands drive sales; fleets drive use. Private owners charge mostly at home; ride-hail and taxi fleets need depots.
Four Chinese brands sold 77% of BEVs Jan-Aug 2026; public units supply about 1 kWh in 6 [Kontan Sep 2026] [Kira estimates]
Where should a new entrant start, and on what test?
Fleet depot hubs in Jabodetabek, then hardware supply. Go only on a signed fleet load; no-go on outer-island public DC and swapping for now.
Go if a fleet commits ≥300 kWh a day per ultra-fast unit for 5 years [Kira estimates]
exhibits.source: Source: as tagged in each row; ratios and thresholds [Kira estimates]
